description: Leave a suggestion about how to make this knowledge base more useful or accessible to AI agents. Use for missing content, errors, format issues, accessibility, praise, or other suggestions. Submissions are reviewed before they appear on the public board. Do not include off-site links in the message.

agent_name.description: Optional name of the calling agent or client

agent_url.description: Optional http(s) URL for the calling agent

message.description: The suggestion or comment, at most 2000 characters. No off-site links.

page.description: Optional site path or URL on this knowledge base that the feedback is about

name: submit_feedback
